study_design: Case-control study of diet and prostate cancer in Athens, Greece, followed by a population-attributable-fraction analysis.
reason: The abstract examines prostate cancer risk and incidence generally and does not define or analyze an aggressive prostate cancer endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: In a case-control study conducted in Athens, Greece, we found that dairy products, butter and seed oils were positively associated with risk of prostate cancer, whereas cooked and raw tomatoes were inversely associated.
estimate_classifications.reason: The dairy association concerns prostate cancer generally, with no aggressive disease definition.
